mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.executed_count), 0) AS executed, COALESCE(SUM(t.success_count), 0) AS success, COALESCE(SUM(t.fail_count), 0) AS fail FROM execution_daily_stat t
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.case_id) FROM execution_case_daily_stat t
SELECT p.test_team AS testTeam, COUNT(1) AS totalCases FROM test_case tc JOIN project p ON p.id = tc.project_id GROUP BY p.test_team

SELECT t.stat_date AS date, COALESCE(SUM(t.executed_count), 0) AS executed, COALESCE(SUM(t.success_count), 0) AS success, COALESCE(SUM(t.fail_count), 0) AS fail FROM execution_daily_stat t
GROUP BY t.stat_date ORDER BY t.stat_date

SELECT DATE_SUB(t.stat_date, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(t.stat_date) DAY) AS date, COALESCE(SUM(t.executed_count), 0) AS executed, COALESCE(SUM(t.success_count), 0) AS success, COALESCE(SUM(t.fail_count), 0) AS fail FROM execution_daily_stat t
GROUP BY DATE_SUB(t.stat_date, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(t.stat_date) DAY) ORDER BY date
SELECT t.test_team AS testTeam, COUNT(DISTINCT t.case_id) AS covered FROM execution_case_daily_stat t WHERE t.stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY t.test_team

SELECT s.case_id AS caseId, tc.name AS caseName, COALESCE(SUM(s.executed_count), 0) AS executed, COALESCE(SUM(s.success_count), 0) AS success, COALESCE(SUM(s.fail_count), 0) AS fail FROM execution_case_daily_stat s LEFT JOIN test_case tc ON tc.id = s.case_id WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} AND s.stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY s.case_id, tc.name ORDER BY fail DESC, executed DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.exec_type AS execType, COALESCE(SUM(t.executed_count), 0) AS executed, COALESCE(SUM(t.success_count), 0) AS success, COALESCE(SUM(t.fail_count), 0) AS fail FROM execution_daily_stat t
GROUP BY t.exec_type ORDER BY executed DESC

SELECT t.test_team AS testTeam, t.exec_type AS execType, COALESCE(SUM(t.executed_count), 0) AS executed, COALESCE(SUM(t.success_count), 0) AS success, COALESCE(SUM(t.fail_count), 0) AS fail FROM execution_daily_stat t WHERE t.stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY t.test_team, t.exec_type

SELECT s.case_id AS caseId, s.exec_type AS execType, COALESCE(SUM(s.executed_count), 0) AS executed, COALESCE(SUM(s.success_count), 0) AS success, COALESCE(SUM(s.fail_count), 0) AS fail FROM execution_case_daily_stat s WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} AND s.stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY s.case_id, s.exec_type
